name: Stone Elemental
primary:
A stone elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
A sturdy stone brawler that walks next to you and fights up close, punching every 0.8 s:
• Damage 3.5 ❤ earth
• Stun for 1 s
• Strong knockback
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
